summary: Master SME management, rolling cash flow forecasting, and operational scaling systems. Build bankable, resilient business operations. Register today.
lede: Small business growth management helps owner-managers and enterprise leads structure daily operations and plan expansion. The programme develops practical skills in assessing unit economics, forecasting cash flow, and standardizing inventory and fulfilment processes, alongside customer segmentation and sales-channel planning.
audienceIntro: This programme serves owner-managers, growth leaders, and enterprise decision-makers responsible for establishing, stabilizing, and scaling commercial operations in competitive markets.
modules: Enterprise Foundation and Business Model Validation
Unit Economics and Financial Baseline Assessment
Working Capital and Cash Flow Engineering
Commercial Sales Engines and Distribution Strategy
Digital Workflow Integration and Inventory Control
Enterprise Governance, Compliance, and Risk Control
Capital Raising and Strategic Expansion Roadmapping
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 12 months of experience operating, managing, or supervising a registered commercial business or active trading enterprise. Basic working familiarity with spreadsheets (creating simple formulas, entering numeric data) and access to baseline enterprise financial or sales records is recommended for workshop exercises.
